blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 室内场景中的单人占用预测旨在从单一的RGB图像中恢复出场景的3D几何和语义. 现有方法仅限于一组封闭的预先界定的类别,将其概括到隐蔽类别的能力受到限制. 在室内场景中,这种限制特别关键,在室内,物体表现出高度多样和精细的语义类别. 我们研究室内场景的开放式伏特加单人入住预测,并介绍OVM-Occ,这是一个高斯式入住框架,具有实例意识的视觉语言教师. 具体来说,我们采用语言-嵌入式高斯语作为中间场景代表,提出几何-感知可变的注意力模块来完善高斯语语义特征,并构建实例级视觉语言嵌入来提供可靠的语义监督. 我们进一步引入了几何-知觉分解语义分解法来减轻几何学和语义学之间的干扰. 为了评价开放-vocabulary入住预测性能,我们引入了OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica这两个扩展基准,其语义分类更为多样和精细. 实验显示,我们的方法在室内场景的开放-省道单人占用预测中实现了最先进的性能,在Occ-ScanNet数据集上以12.2 mIoU和0.6 IoU的优于之前的先进方法,在新的开放-省道评价协议下取得了一致的收益.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
A comprehensive understanding of the surrounding 3D environment is fundamental to embodied perception, robotic navigation, and physical interaction [ 1 , 2 ] .
Occupancy prediction represents the environment as a dense volumetric grid, jointly estimating the occupancy state of each spatial element and assigning semantic labels to occupied regions [ 3 ] .
This unified representation, which integrates geometry and semantics, supports fine-grained spatial reasoning and downstream embodied tasks [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
全面了解周围的三维环境对于体现知觉、机器人导航和物理互动[1、2]至关重要。
占用预测作为密集的体积网代表环境,共同估计每个空间元素的占用状况并给占用区域分配语义标签[3].
这种将几何学和语义学融合在一起的统一表述支持精细的空间推理和下游所体现的任务[4].

blocks.en:
Vision-based occupancy prediction has rapidly advanced in autonomous driving scenarios [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] ,
where multi-view images provide strong geometric and semantic cues.
By contrast, indoor occupancy prediction is more challenging and comparatively underexplored due to denser layouts and more severe occlusions.
These challenges become even more pronounced in the monocular setting, where 3D occupancy must be inferred from a single RGB image without multi-view constraints.
Recent methods [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] have explored Gaussian-based representations for occupancy prediction, achieving promising improvements in indoor scenes.
blocks.zh:
基于愿景的入住预测在自主驾驶情景[5,6,7,8]中迅速得到推进.
其中多视图图像提供强烈的几何和语义提示.
相形之下,室内入住预测更具挑战性,而由于布局更密集和更严重的入住性,相对而言更缺乏探索.
这些挑战在单人设定中变得更加明显,在单人设定中,必须从单一RGB图像中推断出3D占用,而不受多视图限制.
近代方法[9,10,11]为入住预测探索了基于高斯的表述,实现了室内场景的有希望的改善.

blocks.en:
In addition to geometric complexity, indoor scenes contain diverse, fine-grained, and long-tailed semantic categories.
However, most existing occupancy prediction methods [ 12 , 13 , 8 ] are trained under closed-vocabulary settings with a predefined set of categories.
This restriction limits their ability to recognize rare or previously unseen objects, motivating the need for open-vocabulary occupancy prediction.
Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as CLIP [ 14 ] and SigLIP [ 15 ] , have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot transferability by aligning visual representations with natural language.
By transferring language-aligned representations into 3D space, open-vocabulary occupancy prediction enables recognition of arbitrary categories beyond predefined label sets via natural-language queries, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh:
除几何复杂外,室内场景还包含有多样,细腻,长尾的语义分类.
然而,大多数现有的入住预测方法[12,13,8]是在封闭式站台设置下培训的,预设了一组类别.
这一限制限制了他们识别稀有或先前未见物体的能力,从而促使人们需要公开的票房占用预测。
视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的近期进展,如CLIP [14]和SigLIP [15],通过将视觉表现与自然语言相配合,证明了显著的零发可转移性.
如图1所示,通过将语言相通的表示方式转移到3D空间,开放式的模拟占用预测能够通过自然语言查询,识别超过预定义的标签套的任意类别。

blocks.en:
Fig. 1: Illustration of open-vocabulary occupancy prediction and its potential downstream applications.
(a) Given a monocular image and arbitrary semantic text queries,
open-vocabulary occupancy prediction infers a query-conditioned 3D occupancy representation.
(b) The predicted 3D occupancy representation can be further projected into a semantic BEV map.
(c) The representation supports language-guided navigation, such as planning a path toward targets specified by language instructions, e.g., ”throw away the rubbish”.
blocks.zh:
发相. 1: 开放式线路占用预测及其潜在的下游应用图示。
(a) 鉴于一个单一的图像和任意的语义文字查询,
开放式车站占用预测推断出一个有查询条件的3D占用代表.
(b) 国家 预测的3D占用代表可以被进一步预测为语义BEV地图.
(c)) 该表述支持语言引导导航,例如规划通向语言指令所指定目标的路径,如“扔出垃圾”。

blocks.en:
In this work, we study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and propose OVM-Occ.
OVM-Occ employs Language-Embedded Gaussians (LE-Gaussians) [ 16 ] as the intermediate scene representation,
and constructs an instance-aware vision-language teacher that integrates visual appearance cues with language semantic anchors,
enabling instance-level feature distillation and open-vocabulary embedding alignment.
The main contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows: • We propose OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based open-vocabulary occupancy framework,
with a geometry-aware deformable attention mechanism to refine Gaussian semantic features and a geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation strategy to mitigate interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. • We introduce an instance-aware vision-language teacher that provides reliable instance-level semantic supervision via confidence-calibrated vision-language fusion. • We introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories for open-vocabulary monocular occupancy evaluation.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches on both Occ-ScanNet and the newly introduced benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们研究了室内场景的开放-vobulary单人占用预测,并提出了OVM-Occ.
OVM-Occ雇用了语言化高斯人(LE-Gausians)[16]作为中间场景代表,
并搭建一个有实证意识的视觉语言教师,将视觉外观提示与语言语义主播融合在一起,
允许实例级特性蒸馏和开口嵌入对齐。
本文件的主要贡献可归纳如下: 我们提出OVM-Occ, 一个高斯式的开放式伏特加式入住框架,
具有能细化高斯语语语义特征的几何-能分解的注意机制,并具有能分解几何语义分解分解策略来减轻几何学和语义学之间的干扰. ^ 我们引进了一位有实证意识的视觉语言教师,通过信心校正视觉语言聚变,提供可靠的实例层面的语义监督。 我们引入了OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica,两个扩展基准,具有更多样化和精细的语义类,用于开放-伏特加单人占用评价.
广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在Occ-ScanNet和新采用的基准上都超过了以往最先进的方法。

blocks.en:
Fig. 2: Overview of OVM-Occ.
Given a monocular RGB image, the Gaussian-based model predicts Language-Embedded Gaussians (LE-Gaussians) and refines their features using geometry-aware deformable attention.
During training, the LE-Gaussians are rendered into camera views for 2D semantic and depth supervision, while being aggregated into voxel representations for 3D geometric occupancy supervision.
At inference, the LE-Gaussians are aggregated into Language-Embedded Occupancy (LE-Occ),
where the occupancy features are matched with query text embeddings via cosine similarity to produce open-vocabulary occupancy predictions.

图2:OVM-Occ概览.

在训练期间,LE-Gausians被制成2D语义和深度监督的相机取景,同时被集成为3D几何占用监督的voxel表示.
推论,LE-Gausis人被归纳为语言-Embed 占用(LE-Occ),
其中占用特性与通过同位素相似性嵌入的查询文本相匹配,以产生开口-vobulary占用预测.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Monocular Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: II-A 独占预测

blocks.en:
Multi-camera occupancy prediction has been extensively studied in autonomous driving and has achieved remarkable performance [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] .
Motivated by embodied perception and advances in visual geometry foundation models [ 17 , 18 ] , recent studies have explored monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scene understanding.
MonoScene [ 12 ] is a pioneering work in monocular 3D occupancy prediction.
ISO [ 13 ] leverages monocular depth estimation to lift image features into dense 3D volumes for occupancy prediction.
Recent works [ 9 , 19 , 11 , 10 ] employ Gaussian primitives as an intermediate scene representation and optimize occupancy prediction via differentiable rendering.
However, these methods primarily focus on improving geometric reconstruction, while semantic modeling remains restricted to predefined label sets, limiting generalization to unseen categories.
blocks.zh:
多相机占用预测在自主驾驶中被广泛研究并取得了显著的性能[5,6,7,8].
受视觉几何基础模型的体现感和进步[17,18]所激发,近期的研究探索了单相入室预测,以了解室内场景.
MonoScene [12]是一款独家3D占用预测的开创性作品.
ISO [13] 利用单向深度估计将图像特征提升到密集的3D卷以进行占用预测.
近期的作品[9,19,11,10]采用高斯原始人作为中间场景代表,并通过可分的渲染来优化入住预测.
然而,这些方法主要侧重于改进几何重建,而语义模型制作仍然局限于预定义的标签集,将通称限制在隐形分类.

blocks.en: II-B Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: II-B 开放式词汇占用预测

blocks.en:
Open-vocabulary occupancy prediction incorporates semantic knowledge from VLMs, enabling semantic understanding beyond predefined categories.
POP-3D [ 20 ] and AGO [ 21 ] establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences through geometric projection and distill the corresponding visual embeddings into voxel representations for 3D occupancy prediction.
LOcc [ 22 ] employs a 2D open-vocabulary semantic segmentation model to generate category-specific masks and distills the corresponding text embeddings into voxel representations.
However, these methods are primarily designed for outdoor driving scenarios with multi-view cameras, and their direct transfer to indoor monocular settings leads to inferior performance [ 9 ] .
LegoOcc [ 23 ] extends open-vocabulary occupancy prediction to indoor monocular scenes under geometry-only supervision.
It introduces 3D LE-Gaussians to jointly model scene geometry and semantics, renders Gaussian semantic features into the image plane, and distills them with vision-language embeddings.
Overall, research on open-vocabulary occupancy prediction for indoor monocular scenes remains relatively underexplored.
blocks.zh:
开放式模拟占用预测吸收了来自VLMs的语义知识,使得语义理解超越了预先定义的类别.
POP-3D [20]和AGO [21]通过几何投影来建立像素到伏克塞尔的对应,并分馏相应的视觉嵌入到伏克塞尔的表示中,用于3D占用预测.
LOcc [22] 使用2D开放-vocabulary语义分解模型来生成特定类别的口罩并分解出相应的文本嵌入到voxel表达中.
然而,这些方法主要用于多视相机的户外行驶情景,它们直接转移到室内单相机环境会导致性能低下[9].
LegoOcc [23] 在几何唯能监督下,将开放-vocabulary占用预测扩展到室内单相机场景.
它引入了3D LE-Gausians来联合模拟场景几何和语义学,使高斯语义特征入入图像平面,并用视觉语言嵌入来分馏.
总体而言,对室内单人场景的开放式车道占用率预测的研究仍然相对未得到充分探讨。

blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了拟议的OVM-Occ框架,图2说明了该框架的总体结构。

blocks.en: III-A Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 三-A 问题定义

blocks.en:
Given a monocular RGB image 𝐈 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} , the goal is to predict a voxel-wise semantic occupancy field 𝐎 ∈ ℝ X × Y × Z × N c \mathbf{O}\in\mathbb{R}^{X\times Y\times Z\times N_{c}} ,
where X X , Y Y , and Z Z denote the spatial resolution, and N c N_{c} is the number of semantic categories.
During training, only binary occupancy labels and depth observations are used, without voxel-level semantic annotations.
Semantic categories are specified only at inference time through text queries.

其中X X,Y Y,和Z Z 表示空间分辨率,而N c N_{c}是语义类数.
在训练期间,只使用二进制占用标签和深度观测,没有voxel级语义说明.
语义分类仅在通过文本查询的推断时间指定.

blocks.en: III-C Instance-Aware Vision-Language Teacher
blocks.zh: 三-实例-了解视野-语言教师

blocks.en:
Existing open-vocabulary occupancy prediction methods [ 20 , 21 , 23 ] typically rely on dense visual embeddings extracted from CLIP-based models as teacher supervision.
However, these embeddings are learned through image-level contrastive pre-training [ 14 ] and inevitably encode background context and irrelevant regions, thereby yielding noisy semantic supervision.
In contrast, LOcc [ 22 ] employs language teacher embeddings together with open-vocabulary semantic masks.
While the language embeddings provide relatively clean category-level supervision,
the semantic masks lack explicit instance awareness, leading to ambiguous supervision around instance boundaries.
Moreover, LOcc ignores rich visual appearance cues, which are crucial for open-vocabulary tasks.
Fig. 3 provides a qualitative comparison of the aforementioned teachers and their corresponding open-vocabulary segmentation results.
To leverage the complementary strengths of both modalities, we construct an instance-aware vision-language teacher,
where language embeddings serve as semantic anchors while visual embeddings provide instance-specific appearance cues,
as shown in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh:
现有的开放-省道占用预测方法 [20, 21, 23] 通常依赖于从基于CLIP的模型中提取的密集视觉嵌入作为教师监督.
然而,这些嵌入是通过图像级对比性预训[14]来学习的,并不可避免地将背景背景和无关区域编码,从而产生出吵闹的语义监督.
相形之下,LOcc [22] 使用语言教师嵌入与开放-vocabulary语义口罩.
虽然嵌入语言提供了相对干净的类别层面监督,
语义口罩缺乏明确的实例意识,导致对实例界限的监督模糊不清。
此外,LOCC忽略了丰富的视觉外观提示,这些提示对于公开的伏特加任务至关重要.
图3从质量上比较了上述教师及其相应的公开-省分结果。
为了发挥两种模式的互补优势,我们培养了一个具有实证意识的视觉语言教师,
其中语言嵌入作为语义锚地,而视觉嵌入则提供实例特有外观提示,
如图4所示。

The category set is then encoded by the CLIP text encoder to obtain language embeddings 𝒯 = { 𝐭 i } i = 1 K \mathcal{T}=\{\mathbf{t}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{K} .
Meanwhile, the categories are used as text prompts for an open-vocabulary instance segmentation model (OV-ISM) to generate instance masks ℳ = { M i } i = 1 M \mathcal{M}=\{M_{i}\}_{i=1}^{M} .
Consequently, each instance mask M i M_{i} is naturally associated with the language embedding of its corresponding text prompt, denoted as 𝐭 ^ i \hat{\mathbf{t}}_{i} .

blocks.en: III-D Geometry-Aware Decoupled Semantic Distillation
blocks.zh: III-D 几何- 智能解析语义分裂

blocks.en:
Semantic-to-geometry decoupling. LegoOcc [ 23 ] renders Gaussian semantic features onto the image plane and applies feature supervision.
During optimization, the gradients from the feature rendering loss are propagated to the geometry branch.
As a result, the optimization may tend to reduce the rendering loss by adjusting Gaussian geometry rather than improving semantic representations.
Meanwhile, the high-dimensional CLIP teacher embeddings inevitably contain noisy semantic responses, introducing unreliable supervision signals into the geometry branch.
blocks.zh:
语义相去相去相去. 乐高cc[23]使 高斯语语义特征被应用到图像平面上,并应用了特征监督.
在优化期间,从特性渲染损失的梯度被传播到几何分支.
因此,优化可能倾向于通过调整高斯几何而不是改进语义表达来减少渲染损失.
与此同时,高维CLIP老师嵌入不可避免地包含有吵闹的语义反应,将不可靠的监督信号引入几何分支.

blocks.en: To address this issue, we detach the gradients of Gaussian geometry parameters in feature rendering optimization: ∂ ℒ sem ∂ θ g = 0 \frac{\partial\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sem}}}{\partial\theta_{g}}=0 (11) where θ g = { 𝝁 , 𝐬 , 𝐫 , α } \theta_{g}=\{\boldsymbol{\mu},\mathbf{s},\mathbf{r},\alpha\} denotes the geometry parameters.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们在特性渲染优化中解析出高斯几何参数的梯度: QQ L sem QQ克 = 0\frac = 0\frac = 部分\ mathcal{ L}_{\ mathrm { sem}}}{\ sept\theta_{g}}=0 (11) 其中 θ克 = {μ, s, r, α }\theta_{g}=\{\boldsymbol{\mu},\ mathb{r},\alpha\} 表示几何参数.

blocks.en:
Geometry-to-semantic decoupling. Inaccurate depth estimation may cause misalignment between projected Gaussian features and image features, resulting in unreliable semantic supervision.
We apply a depth-error-aware mask to filter geometrically unreliable pixels during semantic distillation: M d = 𝕀 ⁡ ( | D ^ − D gt | < τ d ) , M^{d}=\mathbb{I}\left(|\hat{D}-{D}^{\mathrm{gt}}|<\tau_{d}\right), (12) where D ^ \hat{D} and D gt D^{\mathrm{gt}} denote the predicted and ground-truth depth maps, respectively,
and τ d \tau_{d} is the depth error threshold.

Fig. 4: Construction of the instance-aware vision-language teacher.
A large vision-language model (LVLM) extracts semantic categories from the input image,
which are then fed into an open-vocabulary instance segmentation model (OV-ISM) to generate instance masks and into a text encoder to produce text embeddings.
In parallel, a visual encoder extracts dense visual embeddings from the input image.
The text and visual embeddings are fused, guided by the instance masks, to obtain instance-aware teacher embeddings.

文字和视觉嵌入由实例口罩引导而成的引信,以获得有实例意识的教师嵌入.

blocks.en: III-E Training Objective
blocks.zh: 三-E 培训目标

blocks.en:
Geometry supervision. We employ the binary focal loss ℒ focal \mathcal{L}_{\text{focal}} and the Lovász loss ℒ lov \mathcal{L}_{\text{lov}} [ 25 ] to supervise voxel-wise 3D occupancy prediction.
The Huber loss ℒ depth \mathcal{L}_{\text{depth}} is adopted for dense depth estimation in the input view and depth rendering in neighboring views.
blocks.zh:
几何监督. 我们使用二进制焦距 L 焦距 \ mathcal{ L}_{\text{ focal} 和 Lovász 相接焦距 L lov { mathcal{ L}_{\text{ [25] 来监督 voxel-wise 3D 占用预测 。
Huber 丢失 L 深度 \ mathcal{ L}_{\text{ 深度 } 用于在相邻视图中输入视图和深度渲染的密集深度估计 。

blocks.en:
Semantic supervision. We render Gaussian features into the 2D image plane of the input and neighboring views for supervision.
The rendered semantic features are optimized using a confidence-weighted distillation loss ℒ sem \mathcal{L}_{\text{sem}} based on cosine similarity with the teacher embeddings: ℒ sem = ∑ i = 1 M ∑ p s i ​ M i ​ ( p ) ​ M d ​ ( p ) ​ [ 1 − cos ⁡ ( 𝐟 ⁡ ( p ) , 𝐞 i ) ] ∑ i = 1 M ∑ p s i ​ M i ​ ( p ) ​ M d ​ ( p ) . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sem}}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{M}\sum_{p}s_{i}M_{i}(p)M^{d}(p)\left[1-\cos\left(\mathbf{f}(p),\mathbf{e}_{i}\right)\right]}{\sum_{i=1}^{M}\sum_{p}s_{i}M_{i}(p)M^{d}(p)}. (13) Additionally, an auxiliary instance feature contrastive loss ℒ ins \mathcal{L}_{\text{ins}} is introduced to enhance instance-level consistency.

The overall training objective is formulated as: ℒ = λ 1 ​ ℒ focal + λ 2 ​ ℒ lov + λ 3 ​ ℒ depth + λ 4 ​ ℒ sem + λ 5 ​ ℒ ins , \mathcal{L}=\lambda_{1}\mathcal{L}_{\text{focal}}+\lambda_{2}\mathcal{L}_{\text{lov}}+\lambda_{3}\mathcal{L}_{\text{depth}}+\lambda_{4}\mathcal{L}_{\text{sem}}+\lambda_{5}\mathcal{L}_{\text{ins}}, (14) where λ i \lambda_{i} denotes the balancing weight for each loss term.

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate our method on the ScanNet [ 26 ] and Replica [ 27 ] datasets.
The Occ-ScanNet [ 13 ] benchmark provides annotations for only 11 semantic classes, limiting its ability to support open-vocabulary occupancy evaluation.
To address this issue, we construct the OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica benchmarks with fine-grained semantic annotations,
yielding four evaluation protocols: OpenOcc-ScanNet11, OpenOcc-ScanNet20, OpenOcc-ScanNet40, and OpenOcc-Replica35.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们在ScanNet[26]和复制[27]数据集上评价我们的方法。
Occ-ScanNet[13]基准只为11个语义类提供了说明,限制了其支持公开投票占用评价的能力.
为了解决这个问题,我们构建了OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica基准,并附有精细的语义说明,
产生四个评价协议: OpenOcc-ScanNet11,OpenOcc-ScanNet20,OpenOcc-ScanNet40,和OpenOcc-Replica35. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Following prior work [ 13 , 9 , 23 ] , we use overall occupancy IoU and mean IoU (mIoU) over all semantic categories as the evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 继先前的工作[13、9、23]之后,我们对所有语义类别采用IoU的总体占用率和IoU(mIoU)的平均值作为评价指标。

blocks.en:
Implementation details. For teacher construction, we use Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 28 ] for semantic category extraction,
CLIP text encoder for text embedding extraction,
SAM 3 [ 29 ] for open-vocabulary instance segmentation,
and OpenSeg [ 30 ] for visual embedding extraction.
For the student model, following [ 9 , 11 , 23 ] , we employ a fine-tuned DepthAnything-V2 [ 17 ] as the backbone.
The network is optimized using AdamW with a weight decay of 0.01.
The initial learning rate is set to 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and follows a cosine annealing schedule.
The model is trained for 10 epochs with a batch size of 8 on 4 NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs.
For key hyperparameters,
we set the number of Gaussians sampled per ray to N = 8 N=8 ,
the visual weight λ vis = 0.3 \lambda_{\text{vis}}=0.3 ,
the depth error threshold τ d = 0.3 \tau_{d}=0.3 ,
and the loss weights λ 1 = 100.0 , λ 2 = 1.0 , λ 3 = 2.0 , λ 4 = 2.0 , λ 5 = 0.5 \lambda_{1}=100.0,\lambda_{2}=1.0,\lambda_{3}=2.0,\lambda_{4}=2.0,\lambda_{5}=0.5 .
More implementation details will be provided in the released code.

blocks.en:
We compare OVM-Occ with representative open-vocabulary methods, including POP-3D [ 20 ] , LOcc [ 22 ] , and LegoOcc [ 23 ] .
Table I reports the quantitative comparison results on the Occ-ScanNet benchmark.
OVM-Occ achieves state-of-the-art performance among all open-vocabulary methods,
with 60.10 IoU and 33.25 mIoU, outperforming LegoOcc by 0.60 and 12.20, respectively.
We further evaluate the open-vocabulary generalization ability on the OpenOcc-ScanNet benchmark, which contains more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories.
As shown in Table II , our method consistently outperforms baselines under all evaluation protocols.
Notably, OVM-Occ maintains substantial performance gains even under the challenging 40-class protocol, demonstrating the robustness of the proposed method under a significantly expanded semantic label space.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了OVM-Occ与具有代表性的开放式省道方法,包括POP-3D [20],LOcc [22],和LegoOcc [23].
表一报告了Occ-ScanNet基准的定量比较结果。
OVM-Occ在所有开放的省道方法中实现最先进的性能,
与60.10个IoU和33.25个mIoU,分别以0.60和12.20的成绩比乐高.
我们进一步评价OpenOcc-ScanNet基准上的开放-vocabulary通化能力,该基准包含更多样化和精细的语义分类.
如表二所显示,我们的方法一贯超过所有评价协议下的基线。
值得注意的是,即使在具有挑战性的40级协议下,OVM-Occ仍然保持了实质性的性能收益,表明拟议方法在显著扩展的语义标签空间下是稳健的.

blocks.en:
We evaluate few-shot transfer performance on the OpenOcc-Replica benchmark.
As shown in Table III , our method consistently outperforms LegoOcc across all training settings.
With pre-training on Occ-ScanNet, our method achieves comparable semantic performance using only 100 frames from Replica, reaching 14.44 mIoU versus 14.62 mIoU when trained from scratch on 1.1K frames.
With 1.1K frames for fine-tuning, our method further improves to 77.88 IoU and 23.28 mIoU.

如表三所示,我们的方法在所有培训环境中一直优于LegoOcc。
通过Occ-ScanNet的预训,我们的方法仅使用Replica的100帧实现可比较的语义性能,达到14.44 mIoU对14.62 mIo. U从零开始在1.1K相框上训练.
随着1.1K框架的微调,我们的方法被进一步提高到77.88 IoU和23.28 mIoU.

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 presents qualitative comparisons on the Occ-ScanNet benchmark.
Compared with LegoOcc, OVM-Occ produces more accurate semantic occupancy predictions with fewer category confusions.
Moreover, our method preserves stronger instance-level consistency,
assigning coherent semantic labels to the same object while reducing fragmented predictions,
which demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed instance-aware vision-language supervision.
blocks.zh:
图5介绍了Occ-ScanNet基准的质量比较。
相较于乐高奥克,OVM-Occ产生更准确的语义占用预测,分类混乱也较少.
此外,我们的方法保持了更强的例级一致性,
在同一对象上划出一致的语义标签,同时减少零碎的预测,
这表明拟议中的注重实例的视觉语言监督的有效性。

blocks.en:
Fig. 6 presents qualitative comparisons on the OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica benchmarks with the expanded semantic label space.
OVM-Occ exhibits noticeably more reliable and coherent predictions in these challenging settings.
Furthermore, OVM-Occ successfully recognizes long-tail semantic categories (e.g., guitar and bicycle), demonstrating its open-vocabulary generalization capability beyond frequent categories.
blocks.zh:
图6介绍了OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica基准与扩展语义标签空间的定性比较。
在这些具有挑战性的环境里,OVM-Occ明显显示出更加可靠和一致的预测。
此外,OVM-Occ还成功识别出长尾语义类(如吉他和自行车),显示出其开放-vobulary通化能力超越了常类.

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Qualitative results on the OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica benchmarks with more diverse semantic categories.
blocks.zh: 发相. 6: OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica基准的定性结果,语义分类更加多样化.

blocks.en: IV-C Ablation Study
blocks.zh: IV-C 读取研究

blocks.en:
Table IV presents a factorized ablation by combining different teacher embeddings with different student frameworks.
Compared with the Trident [ 31 ] teacher,
the proposed instance-aware vision-language teacher consistently improves semantic prediction by over 8 mIoU points for both LegoOcc and our framework.
Under the same teacher, our framework consistently surpasses LegoOcc, achieving gains of 3.49 and 3.75 mIoU with the Trident and proposed teacher, respectively.
These results verify the effectiveness of both the proposed teacher and student framework.
blocks.zh:
表四通过将不同的教师嵌入与不同的学生框架相结合,呈现出一种因地制宜的缩减。
比起"三叉戟"老师
拟议的有实例意识的视觉语言教师不断改进语义预测,为乐高校和我们的框架都增加了8个mIoU分。
在同一名教师的领导下,我们的框架一直超过乐高,与三叉戟和拟议教师分别取得了3.49分和3.75分的成绩。
这些结果证实了拟议的教师和学生框架的有效性。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Ablation of different teacher embeddings and student frameworks. VL denotes vision-language.
blocks.zh: 表格 四:不同教师嵌入和学生框架的缩小. VL表示视觉语言.

blocks.en:
Table V compares different teacher construction strategies.
The instance-aware vision-language teacher achieves the best performance,
outperforming the pixel-level vision and category-level language teachers by 5.09 and 1.97 mIoU points, respectively.
These results demonstrate that the proposed teacher construction effectively exploits the complementary strengths of visual appearance cues and language semantic anchors.
blocks.zh:
表五比较了不同的教师建设策略.
实事求是的视觉语言老师 表现最好
以5.09分和1.97分的mIoU分分别将像素级视觉和类级语言教师的成绩相较.
这些结果表明,拟议的师资建设有效地利用了视觉外观提示和语言语义锚的互补优势.

blocks.en: TABLE V: Ablation of teacher construction.
blocks.zh: 表五: 师资建设不平衡.

blocks.en: TABLE VI: Ablation of feature refinement modules.
blocks.zh: 表格 六:特征完善模块的制定.

blocks.en:
Table VI reports the ablation results of different feature refinement modules.
In the ”None” setting, only an MLP is used to project Gaussian features into the semantic embedding space, achieving 59.57 IoU and 31.98 mIoU.
Introducing a deformable attention module to aggregate information from multi-scale image features leads to improved performance.
The proposed geometry-aware deformable attention further improves to 60.10 IoU and 33.25 mIoU,
demonstrating that incorporating Gaussian geometric priors enables more accurate feature sampling for Gaussian feature refinement.
blocks.zh:
表六汇报了不同特性改进模块的缩减结果。
在“无”设置中,只有MLP用于将高斯地物投射入语义嵌入空间,实现59.57 IoU和31.98 mIoU.
引入可变形的注意力模块来从多尺度图像特性中汇总信息,导致性能得到改进.
拟议的几何-可变形注意进一步提高到60.10 IoU和33.25 mIoU,
证明纳入 高斯几何前身使得高斯特征的改进能够更精确地进行特征取样.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the effectiveness of different geometry-semantic decoupling strategies during feature distillation, as summarized in Table VII .
Applying only Spatial SG improves mIoU from 31.11 to 32.12,
indicating that decoupling Gaussian geometry from semantic supervision enables more effective feature distillation.
In contrast, Opacity SG primarily benefits geometric occupancy prediction, increasing IoU from 58.38 to 59.39.
This suggests that decoupling Gaussian opacity prevents the optimization from reducing the distillation loss by suppressing Gaussian opacity, thereby avoiding interference with geometric occupancy optimization.
Combining both stop-gradient strategies achieves further improvements in geometric occupancy and semantic performance, demonstrating their complementary effects in mitigating geometry-semantic interference.
Finally, incorporating depth-error-aware masks yields additional gains in IoU and mIoU, indicating that filtering out geometrically unreliable regions provides cleaner semantic supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们评价不同几何-语义分解策略在特征分解期间的有效性,见表七。
只应用空间SG改进了mIoU从31.11到32.12,
表明将高斯几何与语义学监督脱钩可以使特征分馏更加有效。
相形之下,不透明SG主要有利于几何占用预测,将IoU从58.38增加到59.39.
这表明脱钩后高斯通不透明通过压制高斯通不透明来阻止优化减少蒸馏损失,从而避免了几何占用优化的干扰.
将止步策略结合起来,可以使几何占用和语义性能得到进一步改善,显示出它们在减轻几何-语义干扰方面的互补作用.
最后,加入深觉口罩在IoU和mIoU中产生额外收益,表明过滤出几何不可靠的区域可提供更清洁的语义监督.

blocks.en: TABLE VII: Ablation of geometry-semantic decoupling strategies. Spatial SG and Opacity SG denote stop-gradient operations on Gaussian geometry attributes (mean, rotation, and scale) and opacity, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表七:几何-语义分解策略的分解. 空间SG和不透明SG分别表示高斯几何属性(平均值、旋转和尺度)和不透明度的停止级操作。

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Runtime and memory analysis under different numbers of sampled Gaussians N N per ray.
blocks.zh: 表八:在不同的采样高斯人N每射线下运行时间和内存分析.

blocks.en:
Table VIII summarizes the runtime and memory consumption under different numbers of sampled Gaussians N N along each ray.
All measurements are conducted on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU.
Increasing N N from 1 to 8 consistently improves both IoU and mIoU,
indicating that denser Gaussian sampling provides a more complete volumetric representation of the scene.
However, the improvement saturates at N = 8 N=8 ,
and further increasing N N to 16 may introduce redundant volumetric samples, leading to slightly degraded performance while substantially increasing runtime and memory consumption.
Therefore, N = 8 N=8 is adopted as the default setting, achieving the optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh:
表八总结了每道射线上不同数量的采样高斯克星N N的运行时间和内存消耗.
所有测量均用NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU进行。
将N从1提高至8持续改善IoU和mIoU,
表示更密集的高斯采样提供了更完整的场景体积表现.
然而,改进饱和度在N=8N=8,
将N进一步增加到16可能会引入多余的体积样本,导致性能略有下降,同时会大大增加运行时间和记忆消耗。
因此,N=8N=8被采用为默认设置,实现精度与效率的最佳取舍.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based framework for open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes.
OVM-Occ introduces an instance-aware vision-language teacher that provides instance-level semantic supervision by integrating visual appearance cues with language semantic anchors.
Furthermore, geometry-aware deformable attention and geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation enable more effective semantic representation learning.
We establish OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance for open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了OVM-Occ,一个基于高斯语的框架,用于室内场景中的开道单人占用预测.
OVM-Occ引入了一位有实例意识的视觉语言教师,通过将视觉外观提示与语言语义主播融合,提供实例层面的语义监督.
此外,几何-知能变形的注意和几何-知能分解相通的语义分解可以使语义表现学得到更有效的学习.
我们建立了"OpenOcc-ScanNet"和"OpenOcc-Replica",这两个基准具有更多样化和精细的语义分类.
广泛的实验证明,我们的方法实现了最先进的性能,用于开放式的单体占用预测.
